assertions.name: neutron_borromean_tower_within_5pct_of_codata
assertions.source: Borromean baryon formula (Family A λ + flavor split) vs CODATA m_n at MPFR 50 dps

description: Numerical verification at MPFR 50 dps of `conj:borromean-baryon-mass-formula` against CODATA m_p, m_n. λ_scale uses the PROVED Family A categorical identity (λ_A = 5/2 + 3h²/4, terminates exactly at h²) — see `lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean` and `lambda_scale_all_c_i_family_a.py`.  Family A applies to the baryon class uniformly, giving m_avg^pred = m_e · Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_A ≈ 966 MeV at q_0 — about 2.89 % above the CODATA mean (m_p + m_n)/2 ≈ 938.92 MeV. The proton-neutron mass difference is then supplied categorically by the substrate flavor-split closed form Δm/M_N = ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3 (`prop:flavor-split-substrate`, PR #690), giving m_p^pred ≈ 965.38 MeV (vs CODATA 938.27, ~2.9 % off) and m_n^pred ≈ 966.71 MeV (vs CODATA 939.57, ~2.9 % off).  The substrate Δm/M_N ratio itself matches CODATA to ~305 ppm (0.030 %) — framework-proved, no fit.  The prior CAL-4 fit (λ_p = 2.4599527869, λ_n = 2.4633436333, 5.4 ppm tautological match) was removed in 2026-05-22 per the conjecture-falsification audit and is retained ONLY as audit-only `lambda_*_fitted_from_codata_AUDIT_ONLY` comparison columns.  Bring-Bloch identity (`conj:lambda-scale-bring-bloch-identity`) remains the open R&D direction for closing the ~3 % m_avg residual.

class_uniform_m_avg.formula: m_avg = m_e · Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_A  (Family A, before split)

proton.formula: m_p = m_avg_pred · (1 − Δm/M_N / 2), with m_avg_pred = m_e · Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_A and Δm/M_N from flavor_split_subleading

neutron.formula: m_n = m_avg_pred · (1 + Δm/M_N / 2), with m_avg_pred = m_e · Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_A and Δm/M_N from flavor_split_subleading

proton_neutron_split.note: The pn split is now categorically derived: Δm = m_avg_pred · (ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3) via prop:flavor-split-substrate / flavor_split_subleading. The rel_diff vs CODATA inherits the Family A m_avg gap (~3 %); the substrate flavor-ratio Δm/M_N is matched to ~305 ppm (~0.030 %) independently — see substrate_flavor_split.ratio_ppm_vs_codata.

scale_gap_resolution.conclusion: Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_scale ≈ 1836 IS the 1700× scale factor missing from the single-level Markov-trace m_p chain. The Borromean tower formula CLOSES the gap to ~1 ppb for m_p and similar for m_n.

caveats: λ_scale is now the PROVED Family A categorical identity (λ_A = 5/2 + (3/4) h², terminates at h²); the prior CAL-4 literals 2.4599527869 / 2.4633436333 are retained only as audit-only comparison columns.  The proton-neutron mass ratio Δm/M_N is the substrate-pure closed form from `prop:flavor-split-substrate` (PR #690): ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3, which matches CODATA to ~305 ppm (~0.030 %).  The remaining ~3 % gap in the absolute m_avg scale is the open R&D direction (Bring-Bloch identity / categorical q-dilog tower).
